title: next_article and last_article use O(n) linear scan instead of indexed lookup
description: In session/commands/group.rs, next_article and last_article iterate the full article number list to find adjacent articles. With a group having millions of articles this is O(n) per NEXT/LAST command. The article_numbers store supports range queries; these functions should use an indexed min/max or cursor query instead of collecting all numbers and scanning.
